pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-rectangular regions with soft, serrated edge gradients. Patch spatial area is highest on the central flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes toward the posterior and ventral areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, wide, cream-colored pathways forming a grid of Y-shaped and X-shaped junction nodes. The pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively consistent, with slight widening at major intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous, short, brush-like mane silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. Shows high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four avian organisms (oxpeckers) attached to the body: one on the dorsal ridge near the mane, and three distributed across the mid-flank.
